name: atc-reflect
description: Claude Code mod: spots corrections in your prompts ("no, use pnpm") and offers each as a one-line rule above the prompt, to save to CLAUDE.md or ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, edit or skip. remember: <rule> keeps one straight away. Works on Windows, macOS and Linux. Requires Claude Code 2.1.287+.

detect.title: Find rules
detect.description: auto: prompts that look like a correction are checked by Haiku. remember-only: only remember: prompts are kept, and nothing is sent to a model.
